name: Tungnath & Chopta

gallery.caption: The historic stone temple of Tungnath with mountain peaks in the background.
A trekker standing at Chandrashila Peak admiring the 360-degree Himalayan view.
Panoramic ultra-wide shot of Chopta's green meadows looking up towards the Himalayan peaks with sunbeams.
The historic stone temple of Tungnath with mountain peaks in the background.

coverAlt: Mountain meadows near Tungnath and Chopta in Uttarakhand
highlights: Comfortable for small and mid-size groups
introduction: Tungnath is a Panch Kedar temple at about 3,680 metres, and Chopta is the meadow most groups use as a base for that walk. We drive you from Ghaziabad, Noida or Delhi as far as the road allows. The trek, your stay, and how long you spend outside are yours to plan.
roadTravelNotes:
From Ghaziabad the usual hill approach is Rishikesh or Haridwar, then Devprayag, Srinagar, Rudraprayag, Kund and Ukhimath before Chopta.
The last stretch is narrow, so we keep it in daylight and plan a proper halt before it.
Weather can change quickly. We check the road report before leaving Ghaziabad.
Winter snow can close the final climb, so a December to February date needs a local update first.
Leave early, and keep a spare hour for hill traffic.
shortDescription: Meadows and the walk to Tungnath, with the drive starting from Ghaziabad.
recommendedMonths: March–June and September–November, depending on the weather
suggestedDuration: Usually 2–4 days. Tell us if your group wants it shorter or longer.

name: Nainital
introduction: Nainital sits around Naini Lake, with Mall Road on the slope and quieter lakes a short drive away. We pick your group up in Ghaziabad, Noida or Delhi and drop you at the hotel you have already booked. The price covers the vehicle and the driving.
roadTravelNotes:
The climb after Kathgodam is slow. Leaving Ghaziabad before sunrise makes the first day easier.
Weekend traffic builds up near Mall Road, so an afternoon arrival is often calmer than noon.
Bhimtal or Sattal can be added if the group wants another lake. Say so when you ask for a quote.
shortDescription: A relaxed weekend by Naini Lake, usually one night from Ghaziabad.
suggestedDuration: Usually 2–3 days. Easy to shorten or extend.

name: Mussoorie
introduction: Mussoorie is the ridge above Dehradun: a walk on the Mall, a viewpoint, and Kempty Falls if the group still has energy. We handle the drive from Ghaziabad. You choose the hotel and which stops are worth your time.
roadTravelNotes:
Weekend traffic builds on the Dehradun–Mussoorie climb. Leaving Ghaziabad on Friday night, or before 5 am on Saturday, avoids the worst of it.
The Mall is tight for a large vehicle, so send the hotel lane before we leave.
Dhanaulti is a quieter add-on when Mall Road is crowded.
shortDescription: A cool ridge above Dehradun, easy as a day trip or a weekend.
suggestedDuration: Usually 2–3 days. Adjust it to your schedule.

name: Kedarnath
coverAlt: Kedarnath temple area in the Himalayas
highlights: Drive planned to the road head
Dates checked against the yatra season
Room for a full pilgrimage group
Return timed for daylight on the hills
introduction: Kedarnath itself is a walk from the last point cars can reach. We plan the drive from Ghaziabad to wherever vehicles are permitted that season, then the return. The trek, a pony and the hotel night are arranged by you.
roadTravelNotes:
The last point a vehicle can reach changes with the season and with local orders. Send your dates early so we can say where the vehicle will actually stop.
The opening weeks are crowded at Gaurikund and Sonprayag. We keep spare time rather than promising an exact arrival.
If anyone in the group cannot do the walk, tell us before we price the trip.
shortDescription: Road travel for the yatra, as far as vehicles are allowed to go.
recommendedMonths: Usually May–October. The official yatra dates change each year.
suggestedDuration: Often 3–5 days, depending on the route and how much rest the group needs.

name: Haridwar & Rishikesh
coverAlt: Ganga riverfront at Haridwar and Rishikesh
introduction: Haridwar and Rishikesh are an easy spiritual trip from Ghaziabad: the ghats, Ganga Aarti if you want to stay for it, and a riverside halt. We quote the vehicle for the hours you need, including waiting while the group is at the ghat.
roadTravelNotes:
The highway from Ghaziabad is straightforward until you reach town.
Festival and weekend evenings crowd the lanes around the ghats, so we agree a meeting point a little away from the crowd.
Tell us which aarti you want. The vehicle waits there. We do not drop you into a moving procession.
shortDescription: Ghats and a Ganga evening, close enough for a short trip from Ghaziabad.
recommendedMonths: October–March for cooler weather. Pilgrimage trips run through the year.
suggestedDuration: Usually 1–3 days. A same-day trip is possible.

name: Manali
introduction: Manali is a multi-day drive from Ghaziabad, not a quick weekend hop. We plan the Traveller or Urbania around your dates and group size, and we break the journey when the distance needs it. You book the hotels along the way.
roadTravelNotes:
We would rather leave Ghaziabad at dawn, or the evening before, and break the journey, than drive the hills through the night.
The Kullu–Manali stretch slows down in rain and on holiday weekends.
If you want Kasol or Solang, mention it when you enquire so those kilometres are in the price.
shortDescription: A long Himachal drive, broken into days your group can sit through.
recommendedMonths: March–June and October–February. The best months depend on what you want to do.
suggestedDuration: Usually 4–6 days for a relaxed trip. Tell us if you need fewer days.

name: Shimla
highlights: A weekend or a longer stay
introduction: Shimla is the old Himachal capital on the ridge: the Mall, a viewpoint, and Kufri if you want the extra climb. We pick the group up in Ghaziabad, Noida or Delhi and price the days on the road. The hotel and the walk on the Mall are yours to arrange.
roadTravelNotes:
Holiday weekends fill the road up from the plains. Leaving Ghaziabad on Thursday is calmer than Saturday morning.
We do not drive a 21-seater along the Mall. Share the hotel, or a nearby stand, so the walk is short.
Kufri adds time. Tell us if you want it before we close the price.
shortDescription: The Shimla ridge, with pickup from Ghaziabad, Noida or Delhi.
suggestedDuration: Usually 3–5 days. Adjust it to your dates.

name: Jaipur
coverAlt: Jaipur fort and pink city architecture
highlights: A day trip or a longer stay
introduction: Jaipur is a straightforward highway run from Ghaziabad, useful for a fort day or a couple of nights with the family. We provide the vehicle and the driver. Tickets, guides and your stay are not part of the price.
roadTravelNotes:
Most of this trip is highway. Leaving Ghaziabad by 6 am puts the group in the city before the forts heat up.
Tell us the first stop. Amer and the walled city are not a five-minute hop in city traffic.
Pushkar or Ajmer can be a separate day. Mention them if you want them in the quote.
shortDescription: A highway day to the Pink City, with the forts on your own schedule.
recommendedMonths: October–March, when the weather is pleasant
suggestedDuration: Usually 1–3 days. A same-day return is possible.

name: Jammu & Kashmir
coverAlt: Scenic valley landscape in Jammu and Kashmir
highlights: More than one town on the same trip
The season checked before you leave
introduction: A Jammu & Kashmir trip needs a list of towns, not a one-line plan. Tell us whether you want Jammu, Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam or somewhere else, and we will price the vehicle days from Ghaziabad. Permits, hotels and houseboats are arranged by you.
roadTravelNotes:
This is not a straight overnight drive from Ghaziabad. We break it into manageable days.
Weather and local advisories can close a valley road. We will say so before you leave, rather than finding out at a checkpoint.
Name every overnight town when you enquire. A town that is missing from the list is a day that is missing from the price.
shortDescription: A long valley trip, planned in driving days the group can manage.
recommendedMonths: April–October for many valley routes. Confirm the season for your dates.
suggestedDuration: Often 5–8 days, depending on how many towns you want to cover.

name: Ayodhya
introduction: Ayodhya is a pilgrimage drive from Ghaziabad. We set the pickup, the waiting time while the group is inside, and the return. Darshan slots, hotels and priests are not part of our service.
roadTravelNotes:
Festival dates fill the approach roads. Send the travel date before you promise the group a morning slot.
We agree a meeting point that a large vehicle can actually use.
If darshan runs long, the vehicle waits. That waiting time is in the quote, not added later.
shortDescription: A temple trip into Uttar Pradesh, timed around your darshan.
recommendedMonths: October–March is more comfortable. Pilgrimage trips run through the year.
suggestedDuration: Usually 1–3 days. A same-day return is possible on quieter dates.

name: Mathura & Vrindavan
highlights: Temple visits in a day or overnight
introduction: Mathura and Vrindavan are a short pilgrimage from Ghaziabad, and many groups finish them in a day. We price the vehicle for the temples you list. A parikrama package or a meal stop is not included unless you ask for it.
roadTravelNotes:
The drive from Ghaziabad is short compared with the hills, but the lanes inside town are slow.
Festival mornings need spare time. Tell us which temple is first so we are not waiting in the wrong lane.
Govardhan or Barsana is a separate request. Nearby does not mean it is already in the price.
shortDescription: Temple towns close enough for a day trip from Ghaziabad.
recommendedMonths: October–March is more comfortable. Festival days are much busier.
suggestedDuration: Often 1–2 days. Many groups do it as a day trip.

name: Jim Corbett
coverAlt: Forest landscape near Jim Corbett National Park
highlights: One vehicle for the whole group
Drop at your resort or gate
introduction: A Jim Corbett trip is usually a resort and a safari you book yourself. We drive the group from Ghaziabad to the gate or the stay you name, then bring you back. Safari permits are not part of our price.
roadTravelNotes:
Send the resort name and which gate you are using. The approaches around Ramnagar are not all the same.
Leaving Ghaziabad at dawn gets you there with daylight to spare.
If the safari is at dawn, we can arrive the evening before. That extra day is priced only if you ask for it.
shortDescription: A drop at the resort or park gate you have already booked near Ramnagar.
recommendedMonths: November–June. Park zones and activities change with the season.
suggestedDuration: Usually 2–3 days. Tell us if you want an extra night.
